reason: A DeepSeek Harness utility that adds confirmed UI and agent-tool workflows for permanently deleting sessions and related stored state, including optionally stopping running sessions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带风险确认的会话删除功能，并支持通过智能体工具删除会话及相关存储状态。
summaries.en: Adds risk-confirmed UI and agent-tool workflows to delete DeepSeek Harness sessions and their related stored state.

capabilities: Adds UI controls for deleting sessions
Deletes session logs, projection caches, and workspace accounting
Stops running sessions before deletion when confirmed
Exposes an agent tool that can directly delete sessions
